propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py rebuilds identical clean-source wheel and sdist artifacts three times per test run, resulting in unnecessary build duplication
session-scoped per-worker fixtures should build wheel and sdist once with REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234 and return only immutable artifact paths for read-only consumption
wheel-from-sdist and sdist-content tests must reuse shared real artifacts while preserving their exact archive-content assertions
install-from-sdist and empty-env tests must perform distinct real builds by extracting/operating on function-scoped local copies, not mutating shared fixtures
deterministic call-count oracle must verify exactly one successful prerequisite build per pytest worker/session and fail when duplicate builds or missing COMMIT are introduced
